_note: Physics parameters (m_a, m_b, d_a, d_b) are hardcoded in the scripts and NOT set here.
_eval_budget: SA=200, RBM=200, BO=50, PT=1000. Brute force at k=10 on N=40 costs C(40,10)~850M evaluations.
_comment_indices: null = run all expressions; set to a list like [0,1,5] to run specific ones

sa._note: 200 SDP evaluations. T_start=1.0 tuned to 4422 cost function range. alpha=0.95 over 200 steps.

pt._note: 1000 SDP evaluations total (5 chains x 200 steps). Geometric ladder [0.1, ..., 2.0].

bo._note: 50 SDP evaluations total (5 init + 10 iterations). candidates_per_iter=100. num_trees controls the RandomForest surrogate.

rbm._note: 200 SDP evaluations. T_start and alpha control the annealing schedule. learning_rate/decay/n_mcmc_steps are SpinsSDP-internal (ADAM optimizer) and not configurable here.
